info.name: OIDC Groups Mapping
info.summary: Map OIDC token claims to Nextcloud groups with a visual rule editor
info.description:
Decide which Nextcloud groups a user lands in, based on the claims their identity provider puts in the token.
## Features
- **Visual rule editor** — build and reorder rules by drag-and-drop in the admin settings. No JSON required. - **Five rule types** — direct, prefix, map, conditional and template, applied in the order you choose. - **Claim simulator** — paste a sample token payload and see exactly which groups come out, and which rule produced each one. - **Raw JSON editor** — for when you would rather edit the whole configuration at once. - **Additive or authoritative mode** — add to what the user already has, or let the token define the full membership. - **REST API and OCC commands** — read, write and test rules from scripts or the command line. - **Preserve display names** — keep the names of groups you renamed in Nextcloud after they were created. - **Dark mode** — follows the Nextcloud theme.
Works with any identity provider through the user_oidc app, which must be installed and enabled.
info.author: Pierre Strobel
